label: upcoming output of the letter l (anticipatory l-recall)
explanation: Fires when the model is about to output an l. out_tok==l gives 91% firing rate (15.9x lift) and next_out==l gives 73%. During the copy phase it ramps up over the 2-3 steps before an l is output and decays on and after the l step. During the original phase, when the sequence starts with l (or has l at index 1, both output soon after <DEL>), it fires from about t=3 through <DEL>. It grows as <DEL> nears and peaks around the last original tokens and <DEL> (top activations are about 1.2 on sequences like l l l ... <DEL>). It does not fire at t=0-1, is rare at t=2, and is mostly silent when no l is coming up. A later l in the original phase (index >= 2) gives little activation until the copy phase gets close to it. Weak residual activations (<0.2 of max) with no l nearby, often near <DEL> or early copy steps and with mild preferences for x/q/i outputs, are not captured. Some predicted steps at the leading edge of the ramp are inactive. Dev: P 0.80, R 0.67, F1 0.73, mass recall 0.84.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: out_tok=l (+5.59), orig0=l (+5.44), next_out=l (+4.61), orig1=l (+4.39), orig2=l (+3.13), phase=2 & out_tok=l (+2.65). Lower it: phase=2 & in_tok=u (-11.41), phase=2 & in_tok=j (-9.76), phase=2 & in_tok=t (-9.22), out_tok=u (-8.26).
